blind_projection.competing_explanation: The observed gap may be due to missing isolatable mechanism-off rather than model capacity; a plain LIGHTGCN control can test whether rank-aware scoring is the causal wedge or just an incidental wrapper.
expected_evidence: Concentration of any gains or losses on sparse-user and ambiguous-history cases
Matched full-sort NDCG@10 on the frozen split for LIGHTGCN__LGCN_RANK_AWARE versus plain LIGHTGCN
Seed-stable difference under identical train-only fitting and pairwise input
blind_projection.falsifier: If the rank-aware variant is indistinguishable from or worse than the matched plain LIGHTGCN control on full-sort NDCG@10, the proposed causal wedge is not supported.
blind_projection.high_change_justification: No high-change expansion is needed; the proposal is an existing catalog mechanism selected as a static candidate for isolatable control testing.
blind_projection.hypothesis: Under the accepted context gap, a rank-aware LIGHTGCN will only be diagnostically useful if its rank-sensitive term creates a separable effect from plain propagation; otherwise the lack of mechanism-effect updates is better explained by an unisolated control gap than by representational insufficiency.
blind_projection.matched_control_requirement: Plain LIGHTGCN on the same frozen split, same train-only fitting, same pairwise input, and same full-sort evaluation, differing only by removal of the rank-aware operator.
blind_projection.mechanism_change: Select the catalog profile LIGHTGCN__LGCN_RANK_AWARE as the executable candidate mechanism, with plain LIGHTGCN as its matched mechanism-off control.
